name: classes-200k-best
description: Vanilla against vanilla with the munchkin start by class, at 200,000 engine turns instead of 100,000, on classes-1800-200k. The recommended mix is measured separately (classes-200k-recommended.json): its own default already is the munchkin start by class, so pairing it with the munchkin-wdr profile here would just re-measure the same game (confirmed on 4.2.6-bbc-m8, review #39; the same thing happened to this experiment's own first run, 1,800 wasted cells with 0/1350 differing play hashes between the two profiles).
